title: Unary multiplication
notes: 2 times 3 in unary. The first number is copied to tape 2; for each of its 1s, the head on tape 1 sweeps across 111 and writes a 1 on tape 3 for each 1 it passes. Tape 3 ends with 111111.
ops: mark 1|*,_,_ -> copy -,$,- S,R,S; copy 1,_,_ -> copy 1,1,_ R,R,S; copy *,_,_ -> right R,L,S; right 1,1,_ -> right -,-,1 R,S,R; right _,1,_ -> left L,L,S; left 1,1,_ -> left -,-,1 L,S,R; left *,1,_ -> right R,L,S; right 1|_,$,_ -> accept S,S,S; left 1|*,$,_ -> accept S,S,S
